items.summary_en: The US ambassador has inaugurated a planned Polish-American Centre at Kościuszko Mound in Kraków. The centre is meant to bring the two countries closer together. The project has been in planning for some time.
items.summary_ko: 미국 대사가 폴란드 크라쿠프의 코시추슈코 언덕에서 계획되어 왔던 폴란드-미국 센터를 개관했습니다. 이 센터는 두 나라의 관계를 더 돈독히 하기 위해 마련됐습니다. 그동안 준비 작업이 오래 이어져 왔습니다.
items.title_en: US ambassador opens Polish-American Centre at Kraków mound

items.raw_excerpt: Seasonal northeasterly winds will bring cooler temperatures and rain to northern and eastern Taiwan from Monday, with daytime highs forecast to drop to around 27-28 degrees Celsius, the Central Weather Administration (CWA) said Wednesday.
items.summary_en: Seasonal northeasterly winds will bring cooler temperatures and rain to northern and eastern Taiwan from Monday. Daytime highs are forecast to drop to around 27-28 degrees Celsius, the Central Weather Administration said Wednesday.
items.summary_ko: 월요일부터 계절풍인 북동풍의 영향으로 대만 북부와 동부에 기온이 떨어지고 비가 올 전망이다. 대만 중앙기상청은 30일, 낮 최고 기온이 27~28도까지 내려갈 것으로 예보했다.
items.title_en: Cooler, wetter weather forecast in northern Taiwan next week

items.raw_excerpt: Gluten-free diets have become more common across the world, but in the country known for its bread and pastries, finding 'sans gluten' options can still be a challenge in France. Tell us your advice for enjoying France gluten-free.
items.summary_en: Gluten-free diets are common around the world. But in France, a country known for bread and pastries, finding gluten-free options can still be hard. We want to hear your tips for enjoying France gluten-free.
items.summary_ko: 글루텐 없는 식단은 전 세계에서 늘고 있습니다. 하지만 빵과 페이스트리로 유명한 프랑스에서는 글루텐 프리 메뉴를 찾기가 여전히 어려운 편입니다. 프랑스에서 글루텐 없이 즐겨 먹을 수 있는 여러분의 팁을 들려주세요.
items.title_en: Tell us: Your tips for eating gluten-free in France
